chunks: If a woman dies and leaves behind a son and a husband, then the husband receives one-fourth, and what remains belongs to the son. Likewise, if there are two sons or more than that, then the husband receives one-fourth, and what remains after the one-fourth belongs to the sons, divided equally among them. The husband is not reduced below one-fourth in any circumstance, nor is he increased beyond one-half. And the woman is not reduced below one-eighth, nor is she increased beyond one-fourth. And the wife and the husband are not excluded from inheritance in any circumstance.

If she leaves behind a daughter and a husband, then the husband receives one-fourth, and what remains belongs to the daughter, because Allah, Mighty and Majestic, only assigned one-half to the daughter when the two parents are present.
If she leaves behind a husband and two daughters or more daughters, then the husband receives one-fourth, and what remains belongs to the daughters, divided equally among them.

If she leaves behind a husband, a son, and a daughter, or sons and daughters, then the husband receives one-fourth, and what remains belongs to the sons and daughters, with the male receiving the share of two females.

key_terms.بَيْنَهُمْ بِٱلسَّوِيَّةِ: Distributed equally among those heirs mentioned.
key_terms.لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ ٱلْأُنْثَيَيْنِ: The legal rule that a male heir receives the share of two female heirs in this inheritance case.
key_terms.ٱلثُّمُنُ: One-eighth share, mentioned here as the minimum share of the woman in inheritance.
key_terms.ٱلرُّبُعُ: One-fourth share of the estate, here the husband's fixed portion in the presence of offspring.
key_terms.ٱلْمِيرَاثُ: The inherited estate to be distributed among the eligible heirs.

ai.seo_question: How is the inheritance divided when a woman dies leaving a husband and children?
ai.summary: This hadith sets out legal rulings for inheritance when a deceased woman leaves a husband along with children. It clarifies the fixed share of the husband and explains how the remainder is distributed among sons and daughters according to the rules of inheritance.
